title: End Of The Road For European Diesel
section_path: End Of The Road For European Diesel
section_path_text: End Of The Road For European Diesel
summary:
However, tanker ton-miles remain robust for the time being
For many years, the transatlantic arbitrage trade for product tankers consisted of diesel movements from the United States to Europe and gasoline from Europe back to the U.S. Europe was traditionally short diesel and long gasoline, while the reverse was true in the U.S. This has been the basis for a lucrative triangulation trade that product tankers (mostly MRs) are taking advantage of.
